rationale: Although the stock is in an intraday downtrend along with the broader market, the most recent 1-minute candle registered a massive volume print of 940,951 shares (nearly 80% of today's total volume) on an only 8-cent range, lifting the session VWAP directly to the current price ($157.58 vs $157.60 last) and pulling price above the 5-minute 9-EMA ($157.19). Coupled with a wide 7.6 bps bid-ask spread, there is no clear mechanical edge to enter long against the broader bearish trend or short into active upward momentum and block absorption.
